# habs

Measured drawings of the Historic American Buildings Survey, Historic American Engineering Record and
Historic American Landscapes Survey (U.S. National Park Service), from the Library of Congress Prints and
Photographs Division. Works of the U.S. federal government are public domain in the United States
(17 U.S.C. § 105). The Library of Congress states "No known restrictions on publication". Credit is a
courtesy, not a requirement.

Changes: files renamed; sheets downscaled to at most 3,000 px and saved as JPEG. Full-resolution masters
are linked from each file's source page.
